resources.string:
LocalMind keeps what you type on your own devices. There is no account, no analytics and no logging.

What runs on this phone: chat and code with a small model, offline search of a folder you pick, and lossless trim and join of video.

What a phone cannot do here: image generation, large models and video effects. Image generation and vision need your own PC running Ollama or ComfyUI on your own network. That traffic is not encrypted, and LocalMind refuses any address that is not private, loopback or link-local.

There is no web search, because search queries would leave your device.

The internet is used only when you tap Download, to fetch a model from Hugging Face, and for your own PC.

Model output is only shown to you. It never opens links, runs code, reads files or calls anything. A video plan from a model is checked against strict rules and runs only after you confirm it. LocalMind has no accessibility service, so it cannot operate this phone, and that is on purpose.

Models run in an isolated Android process that has no network, no access to your chats or files, and can only read the one model file it is given. A malicious imported file could still crash that process.
Image attached for the next message: %1$s. It goes to your PC only and is not saved in the chat.

Ask anything or paste code.

Load a model on the Models tab to run on this phone, or connect your PC on the PC tab.

Model answers are only shown here. They never open links, run code or control the phone.
Generating. Tap Stop to end it.
This removes it from this phone and cannot be undone.
That image could not be read.
Images need a PC vision model. Turn on Run chat on PC first.
Downloads run only while the app is open. A cancelled or interrupted download resumes.

These sizes suit about 7.6 GB of RAM. Every download is checked against a pinned SHA-256 before it can load. Only huggingface.co and its download hosts are contacted, over HTTPS, and only when you tap Download.
The file is removed from this phone. You can download or import it again.

LocalMind cannot verify this file. A damaged or malicious GGUF could crash the engine or attack it. The engine runs in an isolated process with no network and no access to your chats or files, and LocalMind refuses to load an imported file anywhere else. Load it at your own risk, and only if you trust where it came from.
Optional. Your own PC, on your own network.

Traffic to these addresses is not encrypted. LocalMind only connects to private, loopback or link-local addresses, checked after name resolution, and follows no redirects. Use only a network you trust.
Connect first to see the models.
Text to image on your PC
Image generation on the phone itself is not offered, because this phone cannot do it in a usable way. It runs in ComfyUI on your PC with a simple built-in workflow: 512 x 512, 20 steps.
Search files on this phone, offline.
No web search, because queries would leave the device. Only text and code files are indexed, up to 2 MB each. The index stays in this app\'s private storage.
Search first, then ask about the results.
Lossless trim and join. Originals are never changed.
keep 0:10 to 0:40 of clip 1, then all of clip 2

No effects and no re-encoding. Joining needs clips with the same codec and settings, and anything else is refused. A cut can only start on a keyframe, so a trim may begin slightly before the time you asked for. It stops at the first frame that reaches your end time, so on clips with B-frames it may end a few frames early.
Asking the model for a plan
Check this plan. Nothing runs until you confirm.
